statements.select:
SELECT P.INQ_CD, CONVERT(NVARCHAR(10),CONVERT(DATETIME,P.INQ_RDATE),126) AS INQ_RDATE, ISNULL((SELECT CASE WHEN #language# = 'KOR' THEN NAT_NM ELSE NAT_ENG_NM END AS NAT_NM FROM T_NATION WHERE NAT_CD = P.NAT_CD),'') AS NAT_NM, P.INQ_CHNL, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'INQ_CHNL',INQ_CHNL) AS INQ_CHNL_NM, P.INQ_RUSER_CD, U.USER_NM AS INQ_RUSER_NM, P.USER_CD, ISNULL(U2.USER_NM,P.USER_CD) AS USER_NM, P.INQ_STATUS, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'INQ_STATUS',INQ_STATUS) AS INQ_STATUS_NM, P.INQ_USER_NM, P.INQ_TYPE, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'INQ_TYPE',INQ_TYPE) AS INQ_TYPE_NM, I.INQ_ITEM_NM, P.POST_ARNG, P.DSTR_TYPE, dbo.FN_GET_CODE_NM(#language#, 'DSTR_TYPE',DSTR_TYPE) AS DSTR_TYPE_NM, P.ORDER_YN, P.ORDER_AMOUNT FROM T_PRDT_INQRY AS P LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U ON P.COMPANY_CD = U.COMPANY_CD AND P.INQ_RUSER_CD = U.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_USER AS U2 ON P.COMPANY_CD = U2.COMPANY_CD AND P.USER_CD = U2.USER_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT COMPANY_CD, INQ_CD, ( CASE WHEN COUNT(INQ_CD) > 1 THEN MIN(INQ_ITEM_NM) + ' 외 ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,(COUNT(INQ_CD) - 1)) + '건' ELSE MIN(INQ_ITEM_NM) END ) AS INQ_ITEM_NM FROM T_PRDT_INQRY_ITEM GROUP BY COMPANY_CD, INQ_CD ) AS I ON P.COMPANY_CD = I.COMPANY_CD AND P.INQ_CD = I.INQ_CD LEFT OUTER JOIN T_CODE AS CD ON P.INQ_STATUS = CD.CODE_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN T_DEPARTMENT D ON P.COMPANY_CD = D.COMPANY_CD AND P.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD
WHERE P.COMPANY_CD = #company_cd# AND P.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND P.NAT_CD = #nat_cd#
AND P.USER_CD = #user_cd#
AND P.INQ_RDATE >= REPLACE(#inq_rsdate#,'-','')
AND P.INQ_RDATE <= REPLACE(#inq_redate#,'-','')
AND P.INQ_TYPE = #inq_type#
AND P.INQ_CHNL = #inq_chnl#
AND P.INQ_STATUS = #inq_status#
AND (CD.VALUE_2 = 'PA' OR CD.CODE_ID = 'INQSTAT_900') AND P.INQ_STATUS IS NOT NULL
AND P.DSTR_TYPE = #dstr_type#
AND P.DEPT_CD = #deptGroup#
AND ISNULL(P.ORDER_YN,'N') = 'Y'
AND D.UP_DEPT_CD = #bizGroup# AND P.DEPT_CD IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY P.INQ_CD DESC
